identityUserId.description: `sub` of the user in the identity provider.

ProblemCode.description: Stable problem identity. Clients decide and translate by this value; unknown values fall back to the generic message of the status.

FieldProblemCode.description: Validation code derived from the class-validator constraint (isEmail → IS_EMAIL). Listed values are the documented ones; others may appear.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details with Ginga extensions (code, params, errors, traceId, timestamp).
